verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a stablecoin balance (USDC) held in a Stripe Financial Account, from which funds can be received, stored and sent (public preview). Bridge orchestration documents programmatic on-ramps and off-ramps, which is the product's own fiat-to-stablecoin conversion capability. However, nothing documents an internal transfer or rebalancing flow between a fiat Stripe balance and a stablecoin balance, whether by API or dashboard; payout conversion and payment settlement are one-way flows, not treasury rebalancing. missing for 10: documented internal fiat-to-stablecoin balance transfer/rebalancing API, dashboard rebalancing flow, end-to-end treasury documentation, GA status (Treasury stablecoins are public preview), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can move value between fiat and stablecoin balances on the platform — internal transfers and rebalancing through the API or dashboard, documented end to end

citations.quote: Stablecoins in Treasury (Public preview): Receive, store, and send funds globally with stablecoins in your Stripe Financial Account.
Programmatically support on-ramps, off-ramps, and crypto-to-crypto flows.
A stablecoin balance, held in USDC. Eligible businesses can hold a stablecoin balance in the countries where it’s available
